resources.string: Rules apply when this module uses SUMH. The most specific rule controls mapping; None leaves the original system path visible. Hide hides the target path and its children, even without module files; a deeper rule cannot restore a hidden parent. Spaces are preserved.
SUMH is unavailable. Existing rules are retained; creating or changing a SUMH or Hide rule requires a supported kernel.
Changes are saved for the next boot. Current mounts are unchanged until reboot.
This legacy path mode uses SUMH mapping when the module runs with SUMH. It does not create a separate Overlay or Magic mount.
Remove repeated slashes, . or .. components, and any trailing slash. Paths are not changed automatically.
A rule already exists for this exact path. Edit that rule instead.
A saved rule has an unsupported mode. Edit or remove it before saving.
A module can have at most 256 path rules. Remove a rule before adding another.
The combined rules are too large. Shorten paths or remove rules before saving.
